title: Payload tape in a loop frame
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with state sets $Q_B,Q_F$ and respectively $b,f$ work tapes. Use the state set $Q_F \sqcup (\{0,1\}\times(Q_B\times\{0,1\})\sqcup\{0,1,\ldots,13\})$ for a host machine, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. Take a base configuration on $b+1+(1+f)+1$ work tapes with this host state set, and choose any optional host state, valid input-head position, three tape-content functions from $\mathbb{Z}$ to optional Boolean symbols (for the flag, counter, and payload tapes), integer counter and payload head positions, and Boolean output word. Form the loop-frame configuration by placing the flag tape at index $b$, the counter tape at index $b+1$, and the payload tape at index $b+1+(1+f)$, with the flag head at $0$ and the other two heads at their chosen positions, and using the chosen state, input-head position, and output. The symbol scanned by the last work tape of this configuration is the payload tape's content at the chosen payload-head position.
